sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture and Aseptic Tubing of Ambient Quick-Cook Tapioca Pearls

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (mixed with EU harmonized administrative and company law; unitary national state with no sub-tax jurisdiction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France maintains a network of over 100 in-force Bilateral Investment Treaties; the specific operative BIT is selected once the nationality and residence of each ultimate beneficial owner is declared.
France-China Bilateral Investment Protection Agreement (as applicable to PRC-resident UBOs; signed 1984, supplemented by protocol in 2007, subject to final title verification at onboarding).
France-China Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (signed 27 November 2013, applicable from French tax year commencing 1 January 2015).
European Union Common Commercial Policy and all EU trade and investment agreements applied through TFEU Articles 206-207.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier, Articles L.561-1 to L.561-49-2 and R.561-1 to R.561-60-1 (AML/CFT and beneficial-owner register); Code de commerce, Articles L.123-3, L.123-32, L.123-36 and R.123-133 et seq. (RCS filing and domiciliation); Décret n° 2018-284 of 18 April 2018 (transposition of 4AMLD/5AMLD UBO register); Arrêté of 30 March 2018 (UBO standard forms); Décret n° 2020-118 of 12 February 2020 (post-CJEU adaptation); Order n° 2022-1194 of 31 August 2022 (INPI as sole register operator); Directive (EU) 2015/849, Directive (EU) 2018/843 and Regulation (EU) 2016/679 on data protection.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (restricted register: authorities, Tracfin, and regulated entities have statutory access; public access is limited to a demonstrated legitimate interest under Article L.561-46 CMF and applicable CJEU case law; not a fully public register)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity document of each proposed gérant (manager), legal representative, and ultimate beneficial owner showing 25% ownership or de facto control
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national authority of the document origin; apostille by the issuing State's competent authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille Convention (1961); if the issuing State is not a party to the Apostille Convention, consular legalization at the French Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and current corporate register extract for each corporate shareholder or intermediary entity in the ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry authority of the corporate shareholder's state of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, followed by sworn French translation by a court-certified translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / active status certificate for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization plus sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and proof of source of funds for the proposed capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Depositary bank of the contributing shareholder; if foreign, the bank's compliance attestation must be authenticated
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization of the bank's signature where required, plus sworn French translation of bank statements and attestations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney executed abroad in favor of the French avocat or notaire for signature of the incorporation file
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent administrative authority of the state where the shareholder or manager is located
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization plus sworn French translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based due diligence under CMF Article L.561-5 and R.561-1 et seq. All UBOs, proposed managers, and authorized signatories must be screened in real time against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, French Direction générale du Trésor restrictions, United Nations Security Council sanctions implemented through EU law, and OFAC SDN list for USD/SWIFT LC transactions. PEP screening is mandatory for any foreign politically exposed person holding or controlling 25% or more of the entity. Enhanced due diligence applies where a PEP, high-risk third country, or unusual ownership chain is identified. The compliance file must record the screening date, list version, risk rating, and grounds for acceptance or rejection, and must be retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), operated by INPI; RCS pre-clearance and search via infogreffe.fr; trademark and company name availability via data.inpi.fr.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The SARL's corporate name is registered in the RCS using Latin-script alphabetic characters. Non-Latin script (including Chinese characters) may be used as a trading name or sub-brand, but the official French legal name requires a mandatory romanized transliteration. French accents and other official EU language characters are accepted. The name must be distinctive, must not mislead as to legal form or business activity, must not infringe prior trademarks or corporate names, must not include regulated professional terms without prior authorization, and must comply with French ordre public and the provisions of Loi Toubon when used in French commercial documentation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: France / République / national / officiel (only with ministerial authorization if implying official status)
Ordre / institut / chambre (when implying regulatory or professional-body affiliation)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: There is no statutory blocking reservation in France; the formalities portal records a priority date. If the greffier rejects the proposed corporate name due to identity, similarity, trademark conflict, or a prohibited token, the applicant may either file a revised name without prejudice or contest the rejection within 15 days of notification by requête before the judge supervising the RCS (juge commis à la surveillance du registre du commerce et des sociétés), under Code de commerce Articles L.123-35 and R.123-91. An unfavorable first-instance ruling may be appealed to the territorial Cour d'appel within 15 days, and a final pourvoi en cassation may be lodged with the Cour de cassation within 15 days of the appellate decision. A legal counsel pre-filing clearance report should be obtained to minimize refusal risk before submission.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only for domiciliation of the legal registered office through an accredited domiciliation company for a maximum of five consecutive years under Code de commerce Articles L.123-32 and L.123-36, and only if the domiciliation arrangement includes physical receipt of official correspondence and administrative mail. For an aseptic canned tapioca pearling and food-manufacturing activity, a virtual office cannot satisfy the obligations of food business operator registration, HACCP implementation, or DGCCRF/DDPP supervision, so a real operational establishment with a physical industrial address must exist before production permits are granted.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: For the administrative registered office/domiciliation address, unannounced inspection risk is low, estimated at under 10% per year. For the aseptic food manufacturing facility, inspection likelihood is high: a DGCCRF/DDPP unannounced inspection is statistically probable within the first 18 months of operation, with an estimated probability of approximately 60% for a facility already operating under ISO/HACCP and effectively near-certain at the time of the initial food business registration or agrément inspection.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory legal notice (avis de constitution) published in a Legal Announcements Journal (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: JAL publisher approved by the prefecture of the registered office jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed tariff regulated by prefecture per insertion; prevailing Paris market quote for SARL formation (€120–€180 plus VAT)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI formalite central / RCS incorporation registration including UBO declaration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle) / Greffe du Tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Code de commerce and the INPI fee schedule (approximately €50–€60 for standard SARL registration)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Capital deposit blocking certificate and bank attestation for SARL cash capital
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Banque de France-compliant commercial bank or Caisse des Dépôts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fee for capital blocking certificate (attestation de consignation de fonds) and receipt, between €200 and €300 per operation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of SARL articles of association, manager appointment deed, share subscription sheet, and corporate governance minutes
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French avocat admitted to a Barreau or French notaire
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for an international SARL with two to five shareholders and UBO chain review: €1,800–€2,800 excluding taxes

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / consular legalization and sworn French translation of all foreign corporate, identity, and UBO documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Apostille authorities in the issuing states and French court-certified translators (traducteurs assermentés)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of €50–€150 per document plus €25–€45 per page for sworn translation; estimated 8–12 documents for a cross-border ownership chain

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT and UBO due diligence package: PEP, OFAC, EU, UN, Tracfin screening, beneficial-owner chain analysis, risk narrative, and five-year file retention
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance provider, French avocat, or certified AML consultant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for an international low-risk food manufacturing SARL: €600–€800 flat fee plus per-record screening charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation agreement for first annual period, including legal mail forwarding and document retention
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Accredited domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) registered with the Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rental charge of €350–€700 per year for Paris/business centers subject to Code de commerce Article L.123-32

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Food business operator registration orientation, DGCCRF/DDPP agrément preparation, and HACCP initial documentation for canned aseptic tapioca pearling
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French food-law regulatory consultant or food safety engineer, with eventual DGCCRF/DDPP inspection
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for pre-incorporation food-law preliminary dossier: €800–€1,400 fixed fee; official agrément administrative fees are nominal but inspection costs are chargeable

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title III, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 to R.223-26 (SARL); Civil Code Articles 1832 and 1832-1 to 1844-7 (general company law).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by INPI, with registration effected by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce under the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution d'une société commerciale (formulaire M0) submitted electronically through the INPI Guichet unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital; the articles freely fix the capital, but all shares must be fully subscribed. Cash contributions must be paid up at least to one-fifth of their amount at incorporation, with the balance callable within five years. Funds representing cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked French bank or notarial account before registration; a bank attestation is filed with the RCS. No general escrow account is otherwise imposed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Resolution of the First Corporate Decision of FR_SARL. Unanimously, the shareholders resolve: 1. The share capital of EUR [●], divided into [●] registered shares, is fully subscribed and the cash contributions are deposited in the blocked account at [Bank], with the legally required one-fifth release applied. 2. The registered office is adopted at [Address], France. 3. [Name] is appointed Gérant with sole management power, within the corporate object and subject to the Articles. 4. The Gérant is authorized to publish the legal announcement, submit the M0 incorporation dossier, pay registry fees, and complete all post-registration formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and execute the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders and counsel; a notary is required if real-property rights are contributed or if the founders elect notarial form.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare SARL statuts in French stating the corporate name, registered office, duration, corporate object covering thermal processing, aseptic packing and canning of boba/tapioca pearls, share capital, class of parts, manager appointment, share transfer restrictions, profit allocation and dissolution terms. Have every founder sign each page. If in-kind contributions are used, appoint a commissaire aux apports where required and attach the valuation report.
required_dossiers: Complete draft Articles of Association
Identity documents or Kbis extracts of all shareholders
Report of commissaire aux apports, if applicable
Power of attorney if a founder signs through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any clauses contrary to mandatory SARL provisions before signature; if the notary or valuator raises objections, revise the relevant contribution or redraft the article and re-initial all signature pages.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the statutory notice containing the name, SARL form, share capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, manager's identity and RCS city. Obtain the attestation de parution from the JAL, which will be attached to the incorporation dossier.
required_dossiers: Text of the announcement
Signed Articles of Association or project
Manager's identification
Registered office address confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL requests correction, publish a corrected notice immediately; only the final publication certificate may be lodged with the RCS. Any materially inaccurate publication must be republished.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit cash contributions and obtain bank certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution or notary depository.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked deposit account in the name of the company en formation and transfer at least one-fifth of each cash contribution, or the full amount if chosen. Obtain the attestation de dépôt des fonds. Secure the manager's declaration that he or she is not subject to a prohibition on managing a company, and obtain proof of availability of the registered office.
required_dossiers: Funding instructions and bank receipt
Bank or notarial attestation de dépôt des fonds
Domiciliation agreement or lease for the registered office
Manager's declaration of no disqualification and signed acceptance of office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises AML questions, provide the corporate structure chart and beneficial-owner declarations. If the attestation is defective, request a corrected numbered certificate from the bank before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit the M0 incorporation dossier to the Guichet unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in through FranceConnect, complete the M0 form, select SARL, populate the exact legal object, managers, capital, registered office and beneficial owners. Upload the signed statutes, bank attestation, legal announcement certificate, manager declarations and office title. Pay the online fee; the dossier is then transferred electronically to RCS, INSEE, URSSAF and tax authorities.
required_dossiers: M0 form generated by the Guichet unique
Signed Articles of Association
Attestation de parution of the legal announcement
Attestation de dépôt des fonds
Manager's declaration of no disqualification and acceptance
Registered office title, lease or domiciliation agreement
Beneficial-owner statement (bénéficiaires effectifs)
Commissaire aux apports report, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Guichet unique returns a dossier incomplet notice, respond within the prescribed 15-day period by uploading the requested documents. If the submission is rejected, file a corrected M0 or a modification dossier; a further refusal may be challenged by an application to the President of the Commercial Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration and issuance of Kbis
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce competent for the registered office, acting through the Guichet unique.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The RCS registrar verifies legal compliance and registration formalities. Upon approval, the company is entered in the RCS, and SIREN, SIRET and the APE/NAF code are issued by INSEE. The Kbis extract is delivered and constitutes the company's official corporate identity document.
required_dossiers: Complete electronic M0 dossier (held by the Greffe)
No additional physical dossier at this stage; keep all originals at the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis contains incorrect APE code, officer names or registered office details, file a rectificatif through the Guichet unique. If the registrar refuses entry, obtain the reasoned refusal and apply to the commercial court for review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Activate employer, tax and sectoral licensing obligations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF, DREETS, DREAL, DDPP and the local planning authority.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the URSSAF employer account, establish payroll and social security arrangements, appoint a chartered accountant, and verify whether the canned boba tapioca plant triggers ICPE registration or authorization. File the food business operator declaration with the DDPP under Regulation (EC) 852/2004. Obtain any required planning permit for the physical plant before industrial activity begins.
required_dossiers: Kbis, SIREN and SIRET numbers
Articles of Association
URSSAF registration confirmation
HACCP plan and food hygiene self-checking documentation
ICPE preliminary classification dossier, if applicable
Building permit and occupancy certificate
Insurance certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DDPP requires additional food-safety detail, provide the full HACCP and sterilization validation dossier. If the DREAL places the installation in a stricter authorization category, submit the supplemental impact study and suspend equipment installation until clearance is obtained.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL) for classified installations; Direction départementale de la protection des populations (DDPP) for food business registration and sanitary controls.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Enregistrement ou autorisation au titre des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE), rubrique 2220, together with the déclaration d'activité as a food business operator under Regulation (EC) 852/2004.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL acting for the Préfet; technical coordination with INERIS and the local Agence de l'Eau.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Subject to confirmation by DREAL: a medium-capacity canned tapioca line is normally within the ICPE Enregistrement tier, requiring an étude d'incidence rather than a full EIA. Larger throughputs trigger the Autorisation tier under Article R.181-1 of the Code de l'environnement, with a full étude d'impact, public inquiry and environmental impact assessment before operation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The permit arrêté fixes binding limits. Typical food-processing thresholds for sewer discharge are pH 6.5-8.5, BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, COD ≤ 1,000 mg/L, suspended solids ≤ 100 mg/L, total nitrogen ≤ 100 mg/L and total phosphorus ≤ 10 mg/L; direct discharge to natural waters requires stricter standards. VOC and odor abatement must be provided for starchy drying and aseptic filling lines, and refrigerant F-gas leakage must comply with Regulation (EU) 517/2014. Solid tapioca waste and sludge must be classified and dispatched with a bordereau de suivi when recovered or disposed of.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance requires prior review by the Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours or an approved inspector, including evacuation routes, RIA or sprinkler coverage and ICPE fire compartments. Structural clearance requires an engineering certificate that floors, mezzanines and aseptic tanks comply with Eurocodes and the building permit conditions. Occupational clearance consists of a DREETS labour inspection, a document unique d'évaluation des risques, electrical conformity certification, emergency stop systems, personal protective equipment and medical surveillance for workers exposed to heat, steam or noise.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty; professional tax portal: impots.gouv.fr (espace professionnel). Company creation and SIREN/SIRET allocation are channelled through the INPI Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); customs/VAT export formalities sit with the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI), douane.gouv.fr.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) administering balance-of-payments and external financial reporting; banking supervision is delegated to the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is in the euro area; the euro is fully convertible for both current-account and capital-account transactions. EU Treaty Articles 63-65 prohibit restrictions on payments and capital movements between Member States and, subject to safeguard measures, with third countries. There is no general FX-licence, convertibility approval, or capital-control mechanism for a food-manufacturing SARL; the only applicable frictions are sanctions screening under EU regulations, targeted FDI screening if an investment were made in a sensitive French sector, and bank AML/KYC due diligence. Profit remittance is not blocked by exchange control, but dividend payments must satisfy French corporate law, be recorded in the SARL's accounts, and may carry non-resident withholding tax unless relieved by treaty, the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive, or a domestic exemption. Cross-border payments are subject to mandatory EUR anti-money-laundering data transmission under EU Regulation 2023/1113 and to Banque de France balance-of-payments statistical reporting where the reporting threshold is met.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no surrender obligation, no statutory conversion deadline, and no mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds. An exporting SARL may retain EUR, USD, CNY, THB, VND, or other currencies in its bank accounts without central-bank permission; the mandatory conversion ratio is 0 percent. Export proceeds are subject only to general commercial record-keeping, customs/Intrastat and VAT declarations for goods, and the banking intermediary's reporting of cross-border transactions for Banque de France statistics above applicable thresholds. There is no timeline within which foreign currency must be repatriated or exchanged into EUR.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Cross-Border Trade Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility is Medium-High only as an ancillary collection/payout rail and Low as the principal treasury rail. An EU/EEA payment institution or electronic-money institution may provide services in France through its home-state licence and PSD2 passporting, subject to ACPR notification. An offshore digital EMI domiciled outside the EEA cannot lawfully maintain a resident payment account or hold client funds for a French SARL without obtaining a French or EEA authorisation; relying on such an institution would create licensing, sanctions, tax, documentary-letter-of-credit, and business-continuity risks. EU-licensed EMIs may be used for low-value SEPA supplier payouts and expense accounts, but they are not a substitute for a tier-1 French bank for capital injection, commercial letters of credit, or SWIFT MT103 trade payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no absolute statutory requirement for directors to appear physically under the French Monetary and Financial Code, Article L. 561-5 et seq.; remote opening may be supported by ACPR-recognised video identification, eIDAS-qualified electronic signature, trusted third-party KYC due diligence, or notarial certifications. In practice, for a newly formed SARL with non-resident shareholders and UBOs, tier-1 French banks generally require either a physical visit to the bank branch in France or a certified video interview combined with notarised, apostilled corporate documents, UBO declarations, and source-of-funds evidence. Physical presence is therefore a de facto condition for non-EU ownership even though it is not a de jure legal mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated SARL with no operating history, no financial statements, and share capital not yet credited, creating shell-company indicators.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised or signed statuts; certificate of deposit of share capital issued by a bank or notary; shareholder resolution appointing the manager; INPI/SIREN registration; UBO declaration; executive CVs; premises lease or co-working agreement; supplier and customer purchase orders; twelve-month cash-flow forecast; commercial contracts for tapioca-pearl production or distribution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident, multi-layered shareholding or a foreign parent/trust/SPV that obscures the natural-person beneficial owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete ownership chart down to individuals; official registry extracts and certificates of incorporation for all intermediate entities; UBO declaration filed with the French Trade Register; passport/ID and tax-residence certificates for each UBO; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence, including bank statements, salary records, and share-purchase agreements; apostilled powers of attorney; notarial documents for corporate acts made abroad.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Exposure to sanctioned jurisdictions, adverse media, PEP status, or high-risk trade counterparties in the boba/tapioca supply chain, especially sourcing from Asia.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions-screening reports, PEP and negative-news searches; ultimate supplier and customer list; signed trade contracts and commercial invoices; HS classification and certificates of origin; export/import customs declarations; a written AML/KYC compliance manual; goods-traceability and food-safety records; senior-management approval minutes if any PEP or sanctions-adjacent party is retained.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Missing operational substance or required food-manufacturing licences, raising suspicion of third-party payment routing or money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SIREN/SIRET registration with Code APE 1030Z; food business operator registration or DDPP sanitary approval; HACCP and food-safety certification; import/export licence evidence where required; VAT and corporate-tax registrations; utility bills and lease; payroll and URSSAF filings if employees exist; product insurance certificates; bank references from the initial capital account or notarial escrow.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For a capital injection from non-resident shareholders, use a SEPA Credit Transfer if the remitter is in the EEA or a SWIFT MT103/TT transfer if the remitter is outside the EEA. The funds should be remitted in EUR to the SARL's blocked capital account or operational account in France; no central-bank FX approval is needed because France applies no capital-control surcharge or convertibility restriction. In the payment reference field, state the exact purpose, for example 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION / SHARE SUBSCRIPTION / SHARE PREMIUM — FR_SARL'. France does not prescribe a mandatory ISO 20022 purpose code for inbound capital, but the beneficiary bank will classify the transaction for Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting as a direct-investment capital flow and may request a declaration where the statutory threshold applies. The bank will verify that the remitter is the registered shareholder, the UBO and source of funds are documented, the shareholder resolution and corporate authorisations are valid, and any required legal formality such as deposit of funds, notarial deed for in-kind contributions, or capital-increase publicity has been completed. Shareholder loans should be documented by a formal loan agreement with commercial interest terms and should be referenced as 'SHAREHOLDER LOAN' to avoid misclassification as distributive income.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103/TT for direct payments to non-EEA suppliers of tapioca starch, packaging materials, and logistics services; use commercial documentary Letters of Credit issued under UCP600 by a French tier-1 bank, normally transmitted by SWIFT MT700/MT710, when suppliers require a bank payment undertaking for large one-off container purchases. Use SEPA Credit Transfers to EUR IBAN accounts for EU suppliers and service providers. Documentary collections under URC 522 can support lower-risk open-account transactions. The same bank infrastructure channels export bills, pre-shipment finance, and trade advances. All USD-denominated outgoing payments will be routed through the bank's correspondent network and must be screened for EU and OFAC sanctions, and all Hedging schedules should be confirmed against real commercial receivables and payables.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD and EUR/CNH forward contracts with a licensed French credit institution, supported by an ISDA or French master agreement and documented commercial exposure.
FX swaps for temporary conversion between EUR and USD, CNY, THB, or VND where the bank provides a deliverable quote.
Cross-currency swaps for medium-term USD financing, intra-group loans, or recurring export receivables.
Non-deliverable forwards for soft or restricted currencies such as VND or IDR where no deliverable onshore forward market is available to the French SARL.
FX options and option collars used exclusively to hedge real trade flows, with no speculative leverage, and compliant with EMIR transaction reporting and MiFID II client categorisation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts filing (dépôt des comptes annuels) and management report registration at RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within 6 months of fiscal-year end; deposit with RCS within 1 month after approval and in any event no later than 7 months after fiscal-year close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit triggers registry penalty tariffs and possible court-ordered astreinte; persistent non-filing after formal notice can lead to compulsory judicial strike-off of the SARL

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale n°2065-SD) for corporate income tax (IS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) - Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year SARL: no later than the 2nd business day after 1 May; for non-calendar fiscal years: within 3 months plus 10 days after fiscal-year close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 10% automatic surcharge, 40% penalty in cases of bad faith, 80% for concealed activity, and monthly late-payment interest; criminal director liability may also apply

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual territorial economic contribution declaration (déclaration de valeur ajoutée des entreprises n°1330-CVAE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP via the EDI-TVA electronic filing platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 3 May, or the 2nd business day after 1 May for calendar-year taxpayers; threshold triggers apply above EUR 500,000 in taxable turnover
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure or late filing exposes the SARL to a 10% automatic penalty, late-payment interest, and tax reassessment following administrative control

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner confirmation (confirmation annuelle de la déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RCS registry through the annual accounts filing platform administered by INPI / Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Confirmation due together with the annual accounts filing; any change in beneficial ownership or control must be updated within 30 days after the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or inaccurate UBO declaration exposes managers to administrative and criminal fines up to EUR 15,000 and imprisonment in serious cases; registry may proceed with strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit when at least two of three thresholds are exceeded: balance-sheet total over EUR 4,000,000; pre-tax turnover over EUR 8,000,000; average workforce over 50 employees. Appointment may also be ordered by court or requested by shareholders
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP under the Plan Comptable Général and ANC regulations; IFRS is not required for SARL individual statutory accounts and applies to consolidated accounts of listed or public-interest groups

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL must file and maintain with the RCS a declaration identifying any natural person ultimately owning more than 25% of shares or voting rights, or exercising control. Annual confirmation is made together with the annual accounts filing; share transfers or control changes require an updated declaration within 30 days
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Managers (Registre des gérants)
Minute Book (Registre des procès-verbaux des assemblées et décisions des associés)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 25% corporate income tax rate plus 3.3% social security contributions, subject to R&D tax credits, investment incentives, and other preferential deductions

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1200 - Déclaration de résultat, filed electronically through the impots.gouv.fr portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within the 15th day of the 4th month following the end of the fiscal year (e.g. 15 April for calendar-year companies)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net turnover excluding VAT for the fiscal year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: French SARL records domestic sales and services; non-resident shareholders do not change domestic revenue reporting

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit or loss before corporate tax after all allowable deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Includes adjustments for related-party transactions and transfer pricing compliance

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties of 0.75% per month of tax due, capped at 10% of the tax due; criminal sanctions possible for intentional non-filing

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for qualifying dividends under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive and most tax treaties
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain a French tax residency certificate and submit a treaty benefits claim form via the impots.gouv.fr portal or bilateral competent authority procedures
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% under most treaties; Interest: 0% if not attributable to a permanent establishment, otherwise up to 10%

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50 million consolidated group revenue triggers Master File requirement
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: French Economic Substance Law requires demonstration of adequate local economic activities; manufacturing operations in France satisfy these through physical presence, employment, and operations

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable income or submission of false tax declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties including fines up to 80% of evaded tax, imprisonment up to five years, and full restitution of evaded amounts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal criminal liability, possible disqualification from management roles, and civil restitution claims

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a company without genuine business operations or economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €75,000, potential dissolution, and forfeiture of tax benefits
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for fraudulent management, including prison sentences and civil damages

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement adequate anti-money laundering controls or report suspicious transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to €1 million or 5% of annual turnover, plus criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, fines, and potential imprisonment for willful breaches
